0.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_TALK_ACTOR
0.description: It would be my pleasure to answer any and all inquiries you may have regarding training.

2.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDEMENU_A1_000_1
2.description: Why should I train my race chocobo?

3.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDEMENU_A2_000_1
3.description: What are the benefits of training each attribute?

4.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDEMENU_A4_000_1
4.description: What are hereditary and acquired abilities?

5.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDEMENU_A3_000_1
5.description: When should I retire my race chocobo?

7.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A1_000_01
7.description: As your chocobo gains experience, it will naturally grow stronger. However, should you wish to develop a given attribute, it would behoove you to consider training.

8.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A1_000_02
8.description: Do bear in mind that training can be rather taxing─both physically and mentally. Eventually, your chocobo will receive no benefit from it.

9.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A1_000_03
9.description: This condition is not permanent, of course. Given time and experience, your chocobo will once more grow receptive to training.

10.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A1_000_04
10.description: As for feed, which is an essential component of any training session─a selection of quality blends can be purchased from our tack & feed trader.

11.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A2_000_01
11.description: An excellent question, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Would that every jockey took the time to learn such essential information.

12.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A2_000_02
12.description: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Maximum Speed<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Affects how quickly your chocobo can run.

13.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A2_000_03
13.description: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Acceleration<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Affects how quickly your chocobo can attain maximum speed.

14.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A2_000_04
14.description: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Endurance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Affects how long your chocobo can run before becoming exhausted.

15.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A2_000_05
15.description: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Stamina<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Affects how quickly your chocobo's stamina bar drains.

16.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A2_000_06
16.description: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Cunning<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Affects how effectively your chocobo can navigate a course without slowing down.

17.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A2_000_07
17.description: Your chocobo's attributes will gradually improve as it increases in rank. Use training sessions to reinforce strengths and address weaknesses in its development.

18.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDEMENU_A4_000_2
18.description: As their names indicate, the main difference between hereditary and acquired abilities is the manner in which chocobos obtain them.

19.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDEMENU_A4_000_3
19.description: If a chocobo is skilled with an ability, then there is a possibility that that chocobo's offspring will inherit said ability.

20.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDEMENU_A4_000_4
20.description: These hereditary abilities can prove to be invaluable assets, and a jockey would do well to take note of any <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> chocobo possesses.

21.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDEMENU_A4_000_5
21.description: If you are particularly ambitious, you might even consider arranging a covering to breed a fledgling with an ability of your choosing. Katering at Moogle's Gift Mounts could tell you more...but I digress.

22.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDEMENU_A4_000_6
22.description: In contrast, acquired abilities are a far more simple matter. A qualified trainer such as myself can─with the requisite manual─simply teach these abilities to your chocobo, provided that your chocobo has not already learned another ability in this manner.

23.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDEMENU_A4_000_7
23.description: I can, of course, unteach these abilities as well. You need only furnish me with a vial of lethe water, which our tack & feed trader can provide.

24.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A3_000_01
24.description: Chocobos cannot live this life forever. If you judge that yours has reached its full potential, you may wish to consider retirement.

25.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A3_000_02
25.description: Be warned that, once retired, a race chocobo cannot be re-registered. It is not a decision to be made lightly.

26.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A3_000_03
26.description: Nevertheless, rather than an end, I would encourage you to think of retirement as a new beginning.

27.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A3_000_04
27.description: After all, if you choose to arrange a covering for your retired chocobo, you may be blessed with a fledgling strong enough to carry on its parents' legacy─or surpass it!

28.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A3_000_05
28.description: Once retired, chocobos can no longer participate in sanctioned chocobo races. However, they can be bred, resulting in a new chocobo for you to train and race. This process is called <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>covering<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

29.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A3_000_06
29.description: Upon retiring a race chocobo of rank 40 or higher, you will receive a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>retired chocobo registration form<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Two such forms are required for arranging a covering.

30.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACETRAININGTALK_00234_GUIDE_A3_000_07
30.description: Please be advised that race chocobos less than rank 40 cannot be retired. If you choose to part ways with one such chocobo, it will become the property of the Manderville Gold Saucer, and you will receive nothing in exchange.
